route_guards: Tenant-scoped routes require a selected tenantId in URL.
Benchmark routes are global but may optionally filter by tenant_id.
shared_api_constraints: No binary/multipart upload endpoint exists; ingestion UI must create document records using raw_text and/or source_uri metadata only.
No endpoint exists to execute benchmark runs; frontend can create run records and read results only.
No dedicated endpoint exists to fetch a single benchmark query by id; query detail screens must source query record from prior list/create responses or list/filter endpoints.
Rerank controls are not configurable via API; rerank_score is display-only when returned in benchmark run results.

pages.title: Tenant Home
pages.purpose: Allow users to select an existing tenant or create a new tenant scope for isolated corpus ingestion, search, and benchmarking.
data_requirements: List of available tenants.
Form state for new tenant creation.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Initial page load and refresh after tenant creation.
Create a new tenant from modal or inline form.

user_actions: Browse tenants.
Search/filter tenants client-side by display name or tenant key.
Create tenant with tenant key, display name, deployment model, and cloud.
Navigate into a tenant overview.
loading_states: Create-tenant submitting state with disabled form.

pages.title: Tenant Overview
pages.purpose: Provide a tenant-scoped dashboard showing corpus readiness and recent searchable documents.
data_requirements: Tenant corpus summary grouped by document/source type.
Recent ready documents for the tenant.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load corpus counts and latest activity.
Load recent ready documents, optionally limited client-side or via limit query.

user_actions: Review readiness of document and agent-memory corpus.
Navigate to documents ingestion page.
Navigate to document search playground.
Navigate to agent memory pages.
Open a ready document detail page.
error_states: Invalid tenant id / summary load failure (400).
Empty corpus state when no ready documents exist.

pages.title: Documents List & Ingestion
pages.purpose: Support on-the-fly registration of unstructured or agent-memory documents for the POV and track ingestion progress until ready.
data_requirements: Ready documents list with filters.
Transient list of newly created document ids for polling ingestion status.
Document creation form schemas aligned to document_type and source_type.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Display searchable/ready documents and apply filters.
Create document records for ingestion.
Poll statuses for newly created documents until terminal state.
Optional metadata/status edits if UI exposes admin editing of title, tags, raw_text, or status.

user_actions: Filter ready documents by source type, document type, uploader, date range, and limit.
Create unstructured document record.
Create agent memory document record.
Enter raw_text directly or reference source_uri.
Set access tags, structured metadata, and conversation metadata.
Track ingestion progress for recent submissions.
Optionally edit document metadata/status for correction workflows.
Open document detail page.
error_states: Patch validation error (400) or document not found (404).
Empty state when no ready documents are available yet.

pages.title: Document Detail
pages.purpose: Inspect one document’s metadata and compare chunk outputs across supported chunking strategies.
data_requirements: Single document record including raw_text and metadata.
Chunk list for selected chunking strategy.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load document metadata and current ingestion status.
Load chunks for chosen strategy.
Optional metadata edits from detail page.

user_actions: View document metadata and raw text.
Switch chunking strategy between fixed_length, recursive, semantic, and contextual.
Browse chunk sequence and token/offset metadata.
Edit document metadata if permitted.
loading_states: Chunk list loading when strategy changes.
error_states: No chunks available for selected strategy.

pages.title: Document Search Playground
pages.purpose: Allow hands-on querying of uploaded documents using vector or hybrid retrieval and inspect ranked hits for quality evaluation.
data_requirements: Tenant corpus summary for context.
Search form state: query_text/query_embedding(optional advanced), top_k, num_candidates, vector/text parameters, chunking strategy, source_types, labels, business_attribute_filters.
Search results and optionally hydrated result details.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Optional contextual summary of available corpus before search.
Execute pure vector retrieval.
Execute hybrid lexical+vector retrieval.
Enrich returned chunk hits with parent document metadata for display.

user_actions: Enter search query text.
Choose retrieval mode: vector or hybrid.
Configure top_k and candidate settings.
Optionally choose chunking strategy.
For vector mode apply source type, labels, and business attribute filters.
Run search.
Hydrate/display richer metadata for hits.
Inspect ranked snippets and scores.
Copy results for external comparison.
error_states: Vector search invalid request (400), including missing query_text/query_embedding or invalid k/filter values.
Empty state when no results are returned.

pages.title: Agent Memory List
pages.purpose: Review recent conversation-derived documents stored for agent memory, optionally by user or session.
data_requirements: Recent agent memory documents with optional user/session filters.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load memory documents for selected tenant and optional filters.

user_actions: Filter by user_id.
Filter by session_id.
Adjust result limit.
Open underlying document detail using document id if desired.
error_states: Empty state when no memory documents match filters.

pages.title: Agent Memory Playground
pages.purpose: Test retrieval of conversation-derived memory with access boundaries using required user context.
data_requirements: Search form with query_text/query_embedding(optional advanced), user_id, groups, top_k, num_candidates, chunking_strategy.
Retrieved memory hits and optional hydrated document metadata.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Execute access-aware agent memory retrieval.
Optionally enrich result display with document metadata.
Optional side panel showing recent memory docs for selected user/session context.

user_actions: Enter query text.
Provide required user_id and optional groups.
Set top_k, num_candidates, and chunking strategy.
Run search.
Inspect memory chunks and associated access tags.
Hydrate hits for richer source display.
error_states: Search invalid request (400), especially missing user_id or missing query input.
Empty state when no memory hits are found.

pages.title: Benchmark Queries
pages.purpose: Create reusable benchmark prompts and browse existing queries by scenario/type for later judgmenting and run setup.
data_requirements: Benchmark query creation form.
Benchmark query list filtered by query_type and optional tenant/source/user/chunking filters.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Create a new benchmark query.
Load queries by required query_type and optional filters.

user_actions: Select query_type: document_search, agent_memory, or hybrid_structured_unstructured.
Create benchmark query with optional tenant and filters.
Filter existing queries by tenant, target document type, source types, user_id, and chunking strategy.
Open query detail page.
error_states: List invalid query (400), especially missing query_type.
Empty state when no queries exist for selected type.

pages.title: Benchmark Query Detail & Judgments
pages.purpose: Review one benchmark query in context and manage its relevance judgments used for precision/recall analysis.
data_requirements: Benchmark query record sourced from navigation state or a previously fetched query list because there is no get-by-id endpoint.
Relevance judgments for the query.
Judgment creation form accepting document_id or chunk_id plus grade/notes.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load judgments for queryId.
Add a new relevance judgment.
Fallback list/filter query if page reload requires rehydrating benchmark query context; client must locate matching id from returned list where possible.

user_actions: View benchmark query text and filters if available in client state.
Browse existing relevance judgments.
Create document-level or chunk-level relevance judgment.
Add notes to judgments.
loading_states: Fallback query-context loading if page is directly loaded and app attempts to recover query details through list endpoint.
error_states: Create judgment validation error (400), especially missing both document_id and chunk_id.
Query context unavailable because API lacks get-benchmark-query-by-id endpoint; show partial screen with queryId and judgments only.

pages.title: Benchmark Runs
pages.purpose: Create benchmark run records and review recent runs with aggregate metrics summaries.
data_requirements: Recent benchmark runs list with optional tenant/status/limit filters.
Benchmark run creation form including systems_compared and query_set.
Available benchmark queries for selection during run creation.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load run list and aggregate summaries.
Create a benchmark run record.
Load query ids for selected query_type when assembling query_set.

user_actions: Filter runs by tenant and status.
Create run name, corpus label, systems compared, retrieval modes, chunking strategies, notes, selected query ids, and top_k values.
Open run detail page.
Understand that execution is external to this API.
error_states: Empty state when no runs exist.
Informational state that created run may remain pending until external execution populates results.

pages.title: Benchmark Run Detail
pages.purpose: Inspect one benchmark run’s setup, aggregate metrics, and per-query stored results.
data_requirements: Benchmark run record.
Per-query run results, optionally filtered by query_id.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load run configuration and aggregate metrics.
Load detailed per-query results and latency/precision/recall breakdowns.

user_actions: View systems compared and top_k configuration.
Review aggregate precision@k, recall@k, average latency, and p95 latency.
Filter detailed results by query_id.
Inspect ranked hits, scores, rerank_score when present, and snippets.
error_states: Empty state when run exists but no detailed results have been written yet.

pages.title: Benchmark Run Comparison
pages.purpose: Compare completed benchmark runs across systems and chunking strategies to support side-by-side evaluation discussions.
data_requirements: Comparison rows filtered by tenant, chunking strategies, and system names.

api_endpoints_consumed.usage: Load aggregate comparison data across runs.

user_actions: Filter by tenant_id.
Filter by chunking strategies.
Filter by system names.
Review precision/recall/latency differences across comparisons.
error_states: Empty state when no completed comparisons match filters.
